name: Chicken & Chorizo Rice
description: A one-pot, paella-style supper. The chorizo releases smoky paprika oil that flavours everything.
recipeIngredient: 6 boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large lidded frying pan, then add the chorizo and cook for 2 minutes more until it releases its oil.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, paprika and rice.
Pour in the tomatoes and stock, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes.
Scatter over the peas, cover and cook for 5 minutes more until the rice is tender. Serve with lemon wedges.
